eligibility.player_elig: Players are eligible at their primary position.

division_winner_tiebreakers.label: Division Winner Tiebreaker
division_winner_tiebreakers.short_description: Winning Pct, Total Points, Division Record
division_winner_tiebreakers.value: Ties for division winner are resolved using standings tiebreakers

playoffs_matchup_tiebreaker.label: Playoffs Matchup Tiebreaker
playoffs_matchup_tiebreaker.value: No playoff tiebreaker. Ties are allowed and will have to be broken by the commissioner.

restrict_add_drops_during_playoffs.label: Restrict Add/Drops During Playoffs
restrict_add_drops_during_playoffs.short_description: Teams eliminated from playoffs are allowed to make add/drops.

standings_tiebreakers.label: Standings Tiebreaker
standings_tiebreakers.short_description: Winning Percentage, Total Points, Division Record
standings_tiebreakers.value: Ties in the standings are resolved in this order: Winning Percentage, Total Points, Division Record.

scoring_system.scoring_period: Scoring based on total stats each period.
scoring_system.standings_tiebreaker: Ties in the standings are resolved in this order: Winning Percentage, Total Points, Division Record.

add_drop_deadline.description: Transactions will lock five minutes before the first game on Sunday (excluding Europe games). Players whose teams already played will be locked for the remainder of the scoring period.

add_drop_policy.description: Add/Drops are handled by a waivers process.

add_drop_waiver_max_claims.description: No limit on the number of waiver offers per period.

add_drop_waiver_period.description: Dropped players remain on waivers for at least 1 day(s).

add_drop_waiver_reset.description: The waiver order doesn't reset (always based on prior waivers run).

add_drop_waiver_run.description: The waiver process runs on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday night.

lineup_deadline.description: Lineup deadline is five minutes before gametime for each player.

lineup_policy.description: Managers may set lineups and change players' positions from a list of their eligible positions.

trade_deadline.description: No trades can be made after the trade deadline of 11:59 pm et 11/15/26.

trade_policy.description: Trades must be approved by the commissioner.

trade_post_season.description: Managers may not make trades during the offseason.
